Here are the papers I could verify from PubMed that report patients with CACNA1A-related developmental/epileptic encephalopathy or establish the gene-disease association:

PMID 23934111 - Epi4K Consortium, 2013, De novo mutations in epileptic encephalopathies.
PMID 35722745 - Lipman, 2022, Clinical and genetic characterization of CACNA1A-related disease.
PMID 39474298 - Chipongo, 2024, Epileptic Encephalopathy due to CACNA1A Variant: A Case Report and Diagnostic Challenges from Resource-Limited Settings.
PMID 40184228 - Liu, 2025, Protective effect of CACNA1A deficiency in oligogenic refractory epilepsy with CACNA1A-CELSR2 digenic mutations.

I also found a broader CACNA1A case series that includes epilepsy in the phenotype, but it was not clearly specific to DEE42B from the abstract alone, so I did not list it as a verified DEE42B paper:
- PMID 35041321 - Rudenskaya, 2021, [Diversity of CACNA1A-related disorders].
